name: PA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by about 8 points on the PVI
Incumbent Madeleine Dean is running with a large cash advantage
Prediction markets price Dean near 96% to win
No general-election polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Dean: a Democratic-leaning seat, incumbency, and a fundraising edge of over $1.1 million on hand against a challenger with no reported money. Markets price her at roughly 96%, consistent with a Safe D call.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or a surge of outside spending for Stuski would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Madeleine Dean seeks another term in a suburban Philadelphia district that leans Democratic by about eight points. She enters the general election as a well-funded incumbent, with roughly $1.2 million on hand, while Republican Aurora Stuski has reported no fundraising. No outside groups are spending against Dean, and prediction markets put her chances near 96 percent.

With no public polls or expert ratings in the race, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the money gap. Those all point the same direction, making Dean a strong favorite, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty.
